title: Walk behind a lone tree (the see-through hole)
about: Owner bug 1. Farm, 10:00, the farmer at (9,3) facing up, beside the lone tree whose trunk stands at (7,2) and whose crown hangs over (6-8,1). Walk up to (9,1), then left along row 1 behind the crown to (5,1) (or tap (7,1)): the farmer shows through a small hole that grows in about 150 ms with a checker rim and closes the same way on the far side; the crown keeps its mass around him and nothing pops or flickers. Then walk down past (8,2), beside the trunk, and stand at (7,3) in front of it: nothing is cut there, even with the crown over his hair. Standing still beside the trunk facing up into the crown cuts only the target tile after a moment.
